meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 12-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (orchestrator manual QA plus one gate reviewer) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Review code changes before publishing to npm
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're publishing an npm package and want an AI review before release

howto.what: 当你要做发布前检查时，Claude 会先找出从上次发布以来所有未发布的改动，按功能分组，再同时开展三组检查：每组改动的代码深查、整体质量与安全检查、最终发布综合判断，最后给出能否发布、版本怎么升级及风险提示。
howto.when: 仅当你明确要求做发布前检查时触发；若只说“发布”，不会触发而直接发布。典型说法：“pre-publish review”“release review”“can I publish?”等。

say.text: 请对当前待发布内容做一次发布前审查。
say.note: 启动多层发布前检查，给出完整结论。

say.text: 我要发 npm 包了，先帮我确认现在能否安全发布。
say.note: 会逐层检查未发布改动并给出版本号建议。

say.text: 发布前先看看这轮改动有没有问题，再决定怎么升版本。
say.note: 触发全套发布前审查流程。

howto.what_en: On a pre-publish review request, Claude locates and groups all unreleased changes since the last npm release, then runs parallel layers: per-group deep code review, whole-change QA/security review, and an overall release synthesis. Output: release readiness, version bump suggestion, risks.
howto.when_en: Only fires on an explicit pre-publish review request; a normal publish/release request does not trigger it. Example triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'release review', 'can I publish?'.

say_en.text: Run a pre-publish review of this project; can I release it?
say_en.note: Starts the full review and returns a readiness verdict.

say_en.text: I want to publish this npm package; do a pre-publish check first.
say_en.note: Runs the unpublished-changes scan and the layered gate.

say_en.text: Before we ship, review all unreleased changes for release.
say_en.note: Spawns per-group deep review and a holistic review.
